description: Capability for the settings window (label `settings`, created only by settings_window::open): listen to and stop listening to events (settings://changed, settings://focus, tauri://close-requested), destroy itself on close, and invoke the app commands its page uses (get_build_info, settings_*, local_model*). Least privilege, decision #45; app commands are ACL-checked per label (T-049, docs/decisions/ipc-acl.md).
